'''Vaal Blade Flurry''' is a [[vaal skill|Vaal]] [[channelling]] [[melee]] [[attack]] skill. Upon use, the user will charge up stages in an expanding circle around the user. Upon ending the channel or after reaching 90 stages, it will deal a smaller area attack to each enemy in the circle.

==Skill functions and interactions==
* {{c|mod|Can't be evaded}}: Vaal Blade Flurry ignores [[accuracy]] and [[evasion rating]] for hit chance calculations.
* {{c|mod|50% less Damage Taken while Channelling}}: While channelling, all damage taken is halved to compensate for the inability to move the character outside of instant [[Blink]] skills or triggered movement skills.
* [[Blind]]: Vaal Blade Flurry has 100% chance to [[blind]] enemies within the circle on hit. The skill has an innate increased effect of blind.
* [[Area of effect]]: Scaling area of effect for this skill will reduce the time required to hit 90 stages, effectively serving as a more multiplier to attack speed and reducing overall channelling time.
